bull_bear.body: 100% of rights issue proceeds directed to debt elimination (Rs.200cr) and strategic drilling/acquisitions (Rs.115cr); no dividends or buybacks planned
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Rights issue approval delay; Kyrgyzstan winter commissioning delays; lithium pricing volatility; Mozambique regulatory risk; jurisdictional exposure in Central Asia and Africa; dependence on exploration success for future value
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident, proactive, transparent; management emphasizes operational progress, ESG commitment, and shareholder communication; acknowledges past IR gaps but commits to quarterly calls; strong technical credibility shown
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: Jonnagiri’s refined gold bullion production (not Dore bars) is a value-add; management’s dual role as ex-Geomysore MD creates information lag but ensures technical alignment; Bhalukona’s PGE discovery is a hidden asset with potential platinum group metal upside
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Board approved a "+137 Cr Rs capital raise through CCDs, equity shares and equity warrants to be deployed across exploration, project development and production expansion".
- Kalevala stake: "Increase holding to majority 51% during 2026/7 - requires investment of about US$1-2M".
- Logrosan stake: "Increasing stake to 51% through funding exploration activities", i.e. stake build funded by carrying exploration spend rather than cash purchase.
- The deck says associates "continued to contribute positively, supporting the Group's long-term value creation strategy".
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body: Jonnagiri (India): 27% stake, 12t resource, 500kg FY27 production, refinery operational; Altyn Tor (Kyrgyzstan): 60% stake, 5.6t resource, trial production imminent, 350kg FY27 output; Kalevala (Finland): 32% stake, 4t resource target, feasibility in FY27, production from FY29; Mozambique Lithium: 100tpd plant by FY27; Mozambique Copper-Gold: 95% stake, drill targets identified; Bhalukona (India): Ni-Cu-PGE discovery, drilling to start Jan 2026
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
- Structured around "Two Strategic Verticals": Gold and Critical (Battery) Minerals, held through subsidiaries and associates including DGFZCO, GMSI, Avelum Partners LLC, Kalevala Gold Oy, DGTPL, DGMOZ and DMMOZ.
- Gold vertical spans four geographies: Jonnagiri Gold Project (India), Altyn Tor Gold Mine (Kyrgyzstan), Kuikka Gold Project plus two others (Finland) and gold exploration licenses (Tanzania).
- Critical minerals vertical spans Bhalukona (India), lithium and tantalum exploration (Mozambique), copper exploration (Mozambique) and the Logrosan Tungsten Project (Spain).
- The deck states the Board-approved capital raise "is expected to accelerate Deccan Gold's transition into a production-oriented mining company", framing the company as still substantially pre-production at the consolidated level.
- Consolidated results are said to "reflect ongoing investment in the Altyn Tor Gold Project, which is still in the development stage".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Associate structure] Jonnagiri sits in GMSI, held at 26%; the deck states "Geomysore contributed to 6.35 Cr of profit due to 59 kg of gold sale" and separately reports project-level Q1 revenue of Rs 87,16,02,313 and PAT of Rs 25,62,94,687, with "Deccan Gold share @26% - 6.35 Cr Rs, including deduction from March 2026" - these are associate/project-level figures, not Deccan Gold standalone.
- [Litigation - Ganajur] The Ganajur Gold Project mining lease is being pursued via a Writ Petition before the Karnataka High Court, which awaits the Supreme Court decision in the Indocil case; Deccan Gold has been admitted as an Impleader, and the core issue is the interpretation of Section 10A(2)(b) of the MMDR Act under which Ganajur's rights accrued and vested prior to the MMDR Amendment Act, 2021 are claimed.
- [M&A pipeline] Three new assets/projects are under due diligence with "Potential production by 2028"; growth is framed as "Expansion of existing projects plus inorganic growth".
- [Board changes] Mr. Pandarinathan Elango elected Chairman after the retirement of Mr. Kailasam Sundaram; Ms. Jade Devenish elected non-executive, non-independent Director; Ms. Deepthi Donkeshwar, Independent Director, retired on rotation.
- [Portfolio under review] Tanzania is "under review" and Ganajur is "awaiting court decision".

deepdive.thesis: Deccan Gold Mines has successfully commissioned its Jonnagiri gold plant and is days away from trial production at Kyrgyzstan’s Altyn Tor, marking a shift from exploration to revenue generation; the upcoming Rs.315cr rights issue will eliminate Rs.200cr debt and fund expansion, transforming the company into a debt-free mid-tier gold producer with critical mineral exposure.
